thread:
maria: Hey folks — quick QA on the structured output examples in the function-calling guide. I pulled the PR draft and noticed two small inconsistencies: 1) the example JSON schema uses ``additionalProperties: false`` but the SDK snippets still call out `allow_extra: true`. 2) the example for streaming function outputs doesn't match the new `invocation` envelope. Can someone look?

jordan: I can take point on the schema PR. Which file is it in? 

maria: It's in docs/guides/function-calling/structured-output.md (PR #482). Link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/482 

ali: I skimmed — SDK snippet that needs changing is the Python snippet under "Parse + call". We switched to `Invocation` wrapper last sprint. Example currently shows `tool_output` raw. 

sophia: @ali can you paste the minimal replacement? I'm doing the streaming example. 

ali: Sure — short snippet: 
```python
# before
response = client.call_tool(name="search", input=payload)
# after
inv = client.invoke("search", payload)
result = inv.output.json()
```

sam: For the JSON schema, we should keep `additionalProperties: false` in the canonical example but show a note about using `allow_extra` for permissive parsing in SDKs. Might add a one-liner: "Use strict schema in docs; SDKs provide parsing helpers to accept lenient responses." 

maria: Yes, that note would avoid confusion. Also, streaming example — the PR currently shows an object per chunk; we now emit `invocation.delta` objects. Example needs to be updated to show `delta.type == 'output'` checks. 

sophia: Draft streaming edit: 
```js
for await (const chunk of client.streamInvoke("summarize", prompt)) {
  if (chunk.invocation?.delta?.type === 'output') {
    process.stdout.write(chunk.invocation.delta.text)
  }
}
```

jordan: Nice. Also add a short migration blurb: "If you used `tool_output` in previous SDK versions, replace with `invocation.output` or `invocation.delta` for streaming." 

doc-bot: Reminder: please include a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md and add an SDK snippet test in devex/snippets/tests. 

ali: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR that updates the Python and JS snippets + adds the SDK test. 

maria: Thanks. Can we also fix two dead links? One goes to old `function_calling.md` route. Found by link-checker in PR CI. 

sam: I can hunt them down after ali's PR. Quick checklist: update schema example, replace Python + JS snippets, add migration blurb, update streaming example, fix links, add changelog line, add SDK snippet test. Anyone want to own the doc review? 

sophia: I can review once ali's PR is up. Aim to merge before end of week. :rocket: 

maria: Great — tagging this thread with #docs-sprint and moving to the RFC board. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
